measurement_contract.max_rss_note: maximum resident set size is the rusage value reported by /usr/bin/time -l for the measured command. With -j2 native compilation it is not a simultaneous combined process-tree RSS measurement.
measurement_contract.logical_size_note: Logical directory sizes sum st_size for regular files. Allocated directory sizes are du -sk multiplied by 1024; APFS allocation and clones can affect them.
measurement_contract.gzip_note: gzip -9 bytes are a compression comparison only, not an installer, DMG, or shipped application size.
measurement_contract.scope_note: Standalone probe binaries do not measure a full Tauri application. Results are local macOS arm64 evidence.
measurement_contract.invocation_note: Commands are copied from the recorded tool-call history. Neither --offline nor --locked was passed.
measurement_contract.target_size_note: The originally observed target totals include the later gzip comparison file in each release directory. build_only fields subtract that file using its logical st_size and stat st_blocks multiplied by 512; no compression was rerun.

limits: All inputs and databases are synthetic and isolated from application data.
Bounded cycles describe observed capacity behavior; they do not prove an asymptotic upper bound.

execution_qualification.probe_exit_note: Neither retention attempt captured the Python probe exit code separately. Completion evidence is the full pass:true payload, all expected cycles, final stdout, and empty stderr; the wrapper statuses are retained and are not reported as probe statuses.

limitations: These are standalone release-probe processes, not the HardwareVisualizer app.
The three binaries share the probe runtime and protocol code but link different engine dependencies.
Current resident size and physical footprint are sampled over time; samples within one process are not independent repetitions.
Only differences from before_open within the same process are reported as deltas; absolute cross-process values retain host noise.
Engine configuration and pool state come from the child stage JSON; the driver does not infer them.
No DuckDB internal memory diagnostic query is issued because that query would alter the idle point; child configuration is still recorded.
Fixture setup, application lifecycle, UI, migration, sustained retention, and OS/power-loss behavior are outside this measurement.

memory_source.semantics: current snapshots at each sample; never ru_maxrss

limitations: Standalone Rust executables do not measure full Tauri application binary size, build cost, or idle memory.
The Rust measurements are local macOS arm64 results; cross-platform build and runtime resources remain unmeasured.
Build maximum RSS is the /usr/bin/time -l rusage value, not simultaneous aggregate RSS across Cargo and all -j2 compiler children.
DuckDB memory_limit=128MB is an engine setting and is not a whole-process memory cap.
Idle-memory values are current process snapshots at blocked stages; only within-process deltas use a shared baseline.
Retention CPU and RSS are process-wide and include fixture creation, both engines, integrity scans, checkpoints, and copy compaction.
Retention wrapper exit statuses do not establish the Python probe exit status; the missing probe exit codes remain missing.
The read-only retention audit verifies stored rows and unchanged files but does not resolve the wrapper-status limitation.
gzip values are compression comparisons, not installer or application package sizes.
